svg.title: Fixed rate versus pressure feedback
svg.desc: Three panels show filtered arterial pressure in mmHg, centered 0.75second mean systemic flow in litres per minute, and bounded heart rate in beats per minute. Shading marks resistance reduction from 30 to 60 seconds. These are model calculations, not clinical data.
